d: A Houthi missile strike on a military training camp in Yemen’s Shabwa province has killed around 70 people and injured more than 200, according to local authorities and military officials. The attack targeted Al-Alam camp near Ataq, amid renewed fighting between the Iran-backed Houthi rebels and Saudi-backed Yemeni government forces. The deadly strike threatens to intensify Yemen’s civil war, as government forces push to reclaim Houthi-held territory along the strategically important Red Sea coast. Cary Johnston brings you the details on Firstpost America.
